title: Primary disclosure comparison for telecom infrastructure analogues

cases.interpretation: Total debt was USD 30.619bn (USD 29.310bn long-term excluding current maturities plus USD 1.309bn current); capex far exceeded year cash and OCF; however, this was a diversified carrier with major acquisitions, governance/accounting fraud, large impairment/restate items and other business segments. It cannot isolate fiber overbuild causality. FY2001 accounting data here is the later audited restatement.

cases.role: Fiber entrant; high buildout and funding need; later underwent financial restructuring
cases.interpretation: Company expected significant capex decline after network completion and success-based future capex, but warned it might fail to raise funds or realize asset values. Estimates are contemporaneous management projections and not realized outcomes.

cases.role: Surviving integrated incumbent comparator, fiscal-year aligned to WorldCom/Level 3 calendar 2001; not a matched long-haul fiber entrant
cases.period: FY2001; balance sheet and debt at 2001-12-31
cases.interpretation: SEC-filed company annual report: cash USD 979m, OCF USD 19,773m and cash capex USD 17,371m; balance sheet debt maturing within one year USD 18,669m and long-term debt excluding current maturities USD 45,657m. Sum gives total debt USD 64,326m. Note 14 long-term debt including current maturities USD 51,494m, less USD 5,837m maturing within a year, gives USD 45,657m. Its large local-access, wireless and international incumbent operations have different cash flows and asset mix from failed WorldCom/Global Crossing and long-haul entrant Level 3; this is a survivor balance-sheet counterexample, not a matched causal sample.
cases.extractionLocator: SEC accession 0000950109-02-001438, Exhibit 13, 2001 Verizon Annual Report: “Increase (Decrease) in Cash and Cash Equivalents” p.17; Consolidated Statements of Cash Flows (OCF/capex); consolidated balance sheet “Debt maturing within one year” and long-term debt; Note 14 “Debt” (table: long-term debt including current maturities; less maturing within one year; annual maturity schedule). SEC filing detail: Form 10-K filed 2002-03-20, report date 2001-12-31.

comparabilityLimits: WorldCom restatement means contemporaneous reported data was materially unreliable; use the later audited restated statements.
WorldCom’s acquisition, governance and fraud story differs from a pure infrastructure oversupply shock.
Level 3 was itself restructured and management forward estimates are not actual asset recoveries.
Verizon was a regulated/local-access and wireless incumbent with different demand, customer mix and asset network economics.

No common utilization denominator, per-route-mile capacity, network lease commitments, or realized salvage price was found in these disclosures. Do not infer AI data-center asset recovery rates from telecom impairment/book values.

extractionLog.locator: SEC Form 10-K, restated consolidated cash flow table (F-8); debt note (F-53); restatement overview; long-lived asset note. Cash $1,290m; OCF $2,845m; PP&E additions $6,465m; long-term debt excluding current portion $29,310m; current portion $1,309m; total debt $30,619m; equity reduction $70.8bn; PP&E/intangibles carrying amount $44.4bn adjusted to aggregate estimate about $23.8bn.
extractionLog.conversion: USD millions divided by 1,000 to USD billions. Identity reconciled and checked: 29.310 + 1.309 = 30.619.
extractionLog.limitation: Restated later; aggregate fair-value estimate reflects management/third-party appraisal and impairment process, not a sale transaction.

extractionLog.locator: SEC Form 10-K PDF, MD&A liquidity and capital expenditures (pp. 49–53): FY2001 capital expenditures about $2.3bn; year-end funds available about $2.1bn including cash/securities and undrawn credit; cumulative capital required to FCF breakeven $13–14bn; 2002 base capex estimate $0.2bn.
extractionLog.limitation: Management plan estimate, not realized cash need, asset recovery, or utilization.

extractionLog.locator: SEC accession 0000950109-02-001438, FY2001 annual report: MD&A cash narrative; Consolidated Financial Condition cash flow summary; Consolidated Balance Sheets; Note 14 Long-term Debt. Short source passages persisted in verizon-source-excerpts.json.
extractionLog.conversion: USD millions divided by 1,000. OCF 19.773 less cash capex 17.371 = 2.402; current debt maturing within one year 18.669 plus balance-sheet long-term debt 45.657 = total debt 64.326. Note 14 independently reconciles 51.494 including current maturities less 5.837 = 45.657; 18.669 current liabilities are broader than the note long-term-maturity amount and must not be added twice.
extractionLog.limitation: Diversified regulated/local-access and wireless incumbent, not a matched pure fiber entrant. No utilization measure was found in this extraction; the filing does not isolate fiber overbuild causality.

correctionHistory.correction: Prior text labelled USD 29.31bn as WorldCom total debt. Correct interpretation is long-term debt excluding current maturities; total debt including current portion is USD 30.619bn. Added Verizon FY2001 cash/debt/OCF/capex/maturity schedule extracted from SEC Exhibit 13.
